ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) distribution across approximately 92% of the surface area, with high-intensity (white/beige) pixel clusters at distal extremities and light-gray surface marking interruptions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Homogenous black pigmentation across the central and proximal fluke areas; high-contrast beige/white contiguous blobs at the left and right distal tips; faint, non-contiguous light-gray pixel clusters and linear streaks on the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression; calculated interior angle of approximately 45 degrees relative to the lobe convergence point.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge with high-frequency serrations; pixel-amplitude of peaks varies between 5-15 pixels; serration density is higher on the right lobe's medial edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Lobes exhibit a convex sweep from the notch towards the tips; the right lobe displays a more pronounced upward curvature (convexity) along the trailing edge compared to the left lobe.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast clusters of circular pixel groups (barnacles) localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes; faint circular high-intensity outlines (scars) visible on the medial portion of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Four distinct, unaligned light-gray linear pixel tracks visible on the right lobe, oriented diagonally from the trailing edge toward the central axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle encrustation at both fluke tips; multiple linear rake marks on the right lobe; circular scarring on the mid-right lobe surface.
